GetItem.returns: vanity item record table or nil. Fields the UI reads: itemid (number, primary key; a few paths also accept itemID), name (string), quality (number 0-7, passed to GetItemQualityColor), group (number bitmask over Enum.VanityCategory -- MUST be a number: bit.contains(group, Enum.VanityCategory.AzzarFaire/Seasonal/Consumable) at :235/:246/:213 and GameTooltip.lua:533), description (string; strupper'd at :648 so nil errors for banner items), icon (string, bare icon file name; UI prepends "Interface\\Icons\\"), artwork (string or ""/nil; file name under AwAddons\Textures\Collections\ and \Collections\PreviewItems\), spCost (number, REQUIRED: compared > 0 / ~= 0 at :681/:733/:1307/:1962/:2351), btCost (number, REQUIRED: same), dpCost (number, OPTIONAL: when nil GetDPPrice(itemid) is called), flags (number bitmask over Enum.VanityFlags; bit.contains(item.flags, Enum.VanityFlags.CannotBeDelivered) at :693/:1980 requires a number, :788 has an `or 0` fallback), creaturePreview (number, REQUIRED: compared > 0 at :147; 0 = none; positive = CreatureDisplayInfo id passed to DressUpModel:SetDisplayInfo), contentsPreview (list of item ids, OPTIONAL `or {}`; each is Item:CreateFromID + DressUpModel:TryOn), owned (boolean, OPTIONAL: QueryItems items carry it; falls back to IsCollectionItemOwned). The addon caches records in Store.Items[itemid] and VanityCollectionUtil caches them per itemID until HOT_PATCH_VANITY_COLLECTION invalidates.

QueryItems.args: (searchText:string, categoryFlags:number|nil, filterFlags:number, unknownConst=1, offset:number, count:number). categoryFlags = bit.bor of checked Enum.VanityCategory leaf flags; when nothing is checked the UI assigns Enum.VanityCategory.All which DOES NOT EXIST in SharedXML/Enum.lua (only Weapons.All does), so the native receives nil and must treat nil as 'all categories'. filterFlags = bit.bor of local VanityFilterFlags {Owned=0x1, Unowned=0x2, Purchasable=0x4, Deliverable=0x8, Heirloom=0x10, Manastorm=0x20}; the UI only ever sets Owned (default on: Store_Init forces Known=true every OnShow), Purchasable (dev realms only), Heirloom, Manastorm. 4th arg is the literal 1 (meaning unknown; possibly sort mode). offset = (page-1)*9, count = Store.MaxItemsPerPage = 9.
QueryItems.returns: table { total = number, items = { record, ... } } or nil. nil is tolerated (`or {}`), missing fields tolerated (`result.total or 0`, `result.items or {}`). Records have the GetItem shape and are cached by .itemid (or .itemID); total drives PageCount = ceil(total/9) and the Next/Prev buttons. Called synchronously on every OnShow, every filter/search keystroke (OnTextChanged), every page turn and every UnlockNewItem.

notes: SCOPE: the Vanity Collection store is a Collections-panel tab (StoreCollectionFrame) that browses a server-defined catalogue of cosmetic items (9 per page), previews them on a DressUpModel, delivers owned ones, and purchases with Seasonal Points (item 97397), Bazaar Tokens (item 975001) or Donation Points (real money web shop). It is out of scope for the first CA-focused release but is cheap to keep loadable. LOAD ORDER: LoadOnDemand, depends only on Ascension_Collections (itself LoD, no deps); loaded by VanityCollection_LoadUI from the Collections tab preClick. Two globals it needs come from ADDONS, not FrameXML: TryCacheItem (AscensionUI/util.lua) and WildCard/WildCardDice (guarded). It ASSIGNS into VanityCollectionUtil (FrameXML/Util/VanityCollectionUtil.lua) at load, so that table must pre-exist in the shim. C_HOOK TRAP: Store:HookEvent at :2519/:2520 runs at load time and goes through C_Hook:Register, whose `if not issecure()` branch is a SetAttribute trampoline that expects the OnAttributeChanged handler to be secure; inside an addon on a stock client it never is, so it recurses forever. Ship C_Hook with issecure() forced true for the shim (also unblocks Item.Cache, LiveUpdate HOT_PATCH handling and C_Player.pvePower which are all issecure()-gated). NATIVE CONTRACTS: records are strict -- group, flags, spCost, btCost, creaturePreview must be numbers, description a string; dpCost and contentsPreview optional; icon is a bare file name. QueryItems receives categoryFlags = nil in the default state because Enum.VanityCategory.All does not exist (only Weapons.All), so nil must mean 'all'; filterFlags default is Owned (0x1) because Store_Init forces Known=true on every OnShow; the 4th positional arg is always the literal 1. Store.GroupIcons is keyed by legacy small ints (3,4,5,7,8,15-18) while record.group is a bitmask, so the group icon always falls back to category-icon-featured -- do not 'fix' data to match. STRINGS: ~50 custom GlobalStrings are absent from the Lua tree and from stock GlobalStrings.lua; four of them (CA_FILTER_KNOWN, PURCHASABLE, ITEM_QUALITY7_SHORT, MANASTORM) are used as filter identity keys, so nil breaks filtering logically, not just visually. EVENTS: two are registered by name through C_Hook (ASCENSION_STORE_COLLECTION_ITEM_LEARNED(itemId), ASCENSION_CUSTOM_POINTS_SEASONAL_POINTS_VALUE_CHANGED(old,new)) and were MISSED by the P0 __EVENT__ inventory; two by RegisterEvent (WEB_SHOP_PURCHASE_SUCCESS(), WEB_SHOP_PURCHASE_ERROR(text)). The shim EventBus can fire them either via Frame OnEvent or C_Hook:SendEvent. The unlock toast is gated on PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD having been seen by the Store frame after the LoD load. INVENTORY GAPS: C_VanityCollection is absent from ext-lua-bindings.tsv altogether (its natives surface there as C_CharacterCustomizationUnlocks.RequestDelivery/PurchaseWebShopItem/IsConsolidatedVanityBuff and _G RequestDeliverVanityCollectionItem/GetAscensionSeasonalPoints), so derive contracts from this file, not the dump; GetCustomGameMode/GetItemQuality/GetItemName/IsSeasonalCollectionUnlocked(present)/GetAscensionDonationPoints(present) likewise. SendSystemMessage is stock. WIRE PROTOCOL: DESIGN section 5 has no vanity verbs; a faithful shim needs VANITY OWNED (fragmented id set, KNOWN-style), VANITY DELIVER <id>, VANITY PURCHASE <id> <currency> with RESULT and EVENT ASCENSION_STORE_COLLECTION_ITEM_LEARNED, plus balances (DP can be a constant 0; SP/BT are GetItemCount of real items). QueryItems/GetItem/GetRandomItem/GetDPPrice are synchronous, so the catalogue must be a generated data/*.lua table and only ownership is server state. DP/web-shop paths must be stubbed off (PurchaseWebShopItem -> false, OpenAscensionURL -> no-op, CONFIG_WEB_SHOP_ENABLED -> false). ItemMixin:ContinueOnLoad needs a stock replacement for ITEM_CACHE_REQUEST_SUCCESS (tooltip-driven TryCacheItem + GetItemInfo polling) or the Buy button silently does nothing for uncached items. QUIRKS: the global FontString name StoreCollectionListFrameTitleText is used twice; the addon stores dotted pseudo-globals like _G["StoreCollectionItemFrame1.Button"] (not frame names); Store OnUpdate polls GetRandomItem every frame while the banner is hidden and re-Shows the DressUpModel every 5 frames (HackFix); the model-preview position fix WRITES SetCVar("uiScale","1") when useUiScale is off. The Collections tab id for Vanity is positional and shifts with C_Player:IsHero() and IsCustomClass(); always address it as Collections.Tabs.Vanity.
